failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent physical inputs, genuine poles or unrepresentable scientific response.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear search candidate semantics in this API. Precision/tail failures are explicit ValueError; EM eigen residual and insufficient-selection failures are explicit ValueError where applicable.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Errors return no result; no failed or partial execution is presented as a successful output.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: RuntimeError for unsupported/missing native runtime or abnormal native exit; subprocess timeout is explicit.

assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.

identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.definition: vthermal=sqrt(2 kB T/m), signed rho=sqrt(kB T/m)/Omega, wn=min abs(Omega), kn=1/max abs(rho); source eV conversion retained.
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation
identity.relation: source case listed-species scales and normalization
